results.sqliteSql: SELECT id FROM users WHERE tier IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NULL ORDER BY id

results.name: EXISTS
results.walrusSql: SELECT id FROM orders WHERE EXISTS (SELECT id FROM users WHERE tier >= 3) ORDER BY id
results.sqliteSql: SELECT id FROM orders WHERE EXISTS (SELECT id FROM users WHERE tier >= 3) ORDER BY id

results.name: SOME mapped
results.walrusSql: SELECT id FROM orders WHERE amount > SOME (SELECT tier FROM users) ORDER BY id
results.sqliteSql: SELECT id FROM orders WHERE amount > (SELECT MIN(tier) FROM users) ORDER BY id

results.name: ALL mapped
results.walrusSql: SELECT id FROM orders WHERE amount > ALL (SELECT tier FROM users) ORDER BY id
results.sqliteSql: SELECT id FROM orders WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users) = 0 OR ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE tier IS NULL) = 0 AND amount > (SELECT MAX(tier) FROM users WHERE tier IS NOT NULL)) ORDER BY id

results.name: FROM subquery
results.walrusSql: SELECT d.id FROM (SELECT id, amount FROM orders WHERE amount >= 20) d WHERE d.amount > 20 ORDER BY d.id
results.sqliteSql: SELECT d.id AS "d.id" FROM (SELECT id, amount FROM orders WHERE amount >= 20) d WHERE d.amount > 20 ORDER BY d.id

results.name: correlated IN
results.walrusSql: SELECT id FROM orders WHERE user_id IN (SELECT id FROM users WHERE tier > 1 AND id = outer.user_id) ORDER BY id
results.sqliteSql: SELECT o.id AS id FROM orders o WHERE o.user_id IN (SELECT u.id FROM users u WHERE u.tier > 1 AND u.id = o.user_id) ORDER BY o.id

results.name: correlated EXISTS
results.walrusSql: SELECT id FROM orders WHERE EXISTS (SELECT id FROM users WHERE id = outer.user_id AND tier >= 2) ORDER BY id
results.sqliteSql: SELECT o.id AS id FROM orders o WHERE EXISTS (SELECT u.id FROM users u WHERE u.id = o.user_id AND u.tier >= 2) ORDER BY o.id

results.name: AND/OR precedence
results.walrusSql: SELECT id FROM orders WHERE (status = 'paid' OR status = 'shipped') AND amount >= 20 ORDER BY id
results.sqliteSql: SELECT id FROM orders WHERE (status = 'paid' OR status = 'shipped') AND amount >= 20 ORDER BY id
